def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The framed pattern occupies the left side; the colored shapes are on the right.
    left_color = grid[0][0]
    split = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))), w)
    out = [row[:split] for row in grid]

    # Collect connected components of nonzero colors on the right.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(split + 1, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    p = (y + dy, x + dx)
                    if (0 <= p[0] < h and split < p[1] < w
                            and p not in seen and grid[p[0]][p[1]] == color):
                        seen.add(p)
                        stack.append(p)
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = frozenset((y - minr, x - minc) for y, x in cells)
            objects.append((color, shape))

    # Each framed section has a blank-cell silhouette matching one right-side object.
    row = 0
    while row < h:
        if all(grid[row][c] == left_color for c in range(split)):
            start = row + 1
            end = start
            while end < h and not all(grid[end][c] == left_color for c in range(split)):
                end += 1
            holes = [(y, x) for y in range(start, end)
                     for x in range(split) if grid[y][x] == 0]
            if holes:
                minr = min(y for y, x in holes)
                minc = min(x for y, x in holes)
                shape = frozenset((y - minr, x - minc) for y, x in holes)
                for color, objshape in objects:
                    if shape == objshape:
                        for y, x in holes:
                            out[y][x] = color
                        break
            row = end
        else:
            row += 1
    return out
